issue.title: Circular import between sase.project_aliases and sase.memory breaks test_project_handler_list_show.py collection
issue.description:
tests/main/test_project_handler_list_show.py fails at COLLECTION with a deterministic circular import, so the whole module's tests never run.

REPRODUCTION (2026-08-13, workspace checkout at master 829030f97):
  .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/main/test_project_handler_list_show.py -q
  -> ImportError: cannot import name 'resolve_project_alias_ref' from partially initialized module 'sase.project_aliases' (most likely due to a circular import)

Confirmed pre-existing and unrelated to my change by 'git stash'-ing my working tree and re-running on clean master: the identical collection error reproduces.

CYCLE (from the pytest traceback):
  tests/main/test_project_handler_list_show.py:14
    -> src/sase/main/project_handler.py:29  from sase.project_aliases import ...
    -> src/sase/project_aliases.py:23       from sase.project_alias_prompts import ...
    -> src/sase/project_alias_prompts.py:8  from sase.xprompt._fenced_blocks import ...
    -> src/sase/xprompt/__init__.py:34 -> directives.py:48 -> processor.py:41 -> loader.py:28
    -> src/sase/xprompt/loader_memory.py:15 from sase.memory.notes import collapse_description
    -> src/sase/memory/__init__.py:1 -> src/sase/memory/proposals/__init__.py:8
    -> src/sase/memory/read_log.py:35       from sase.project_aliases import resolve_project_alias_ref  <-- closes the cycle

ROOT CAUSE: src/sase/memory/read_log.py:35 imports resolve_project_alias_ref at module scope, but its only use is inside a function body (read_log.py:370). Because sase.project_aliases transitively imports sase.memory (via project_alias_prompts -> xprompt -> loader_memory -> sase.memory.notes), any entry into the cycle that starts at sase.project_aliases finds sase.memory.read_log re-entering a half-initialized sase.project_aliases. src/sase/memory/proposals/paths.py:9 has the identical module-scope import with the same function-local-only use (paths.py:16) and is the second edge of the same shape.

LIKELY FIX: move both imports into their calling functions (deferred import), or hoist resolve_project_alias_ref into a leaf module that neither side's package __init__ pulls in. Then add a regression check that the module imports in a fresh interpreter -- the test that catches this is named test_project_handler_imports_in_fresh_interpreter, so the intent already exists; it just cannot run because collection dies first.

IMPACT: an entire test module silently contributes zero coverage, and 'just check' reports it as a failure for every unrelated change. Multiple agents (see sase-kt, sase-kq, sase-ku.1) have burned triage time re-confirming it is pre-existing.
